title: PPG-Bench: A Unified Benchmark for PPG Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.13435v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is increasingly recorded by wearable and clinical devices at enormous scale, and a growing number of PPG foundation models (FMs) have been developed to compute reusable representations for various downstream tasks. These models are difficult to compare: different evaluations use different datasets, task definitions, preprocessing, downstream heads, hyperparameter tuning, and baselines. We present PPG-Bench, a unifying open-source benchmark evaluating five public PPG FMs across nine open-access datasets and 26 tasks spanning cardiovascular state estimation, activity, sleep, screening, and identification. We evaluate models under four downstream regimes of increasing adaptability (linear probing, random forests, frozen MLP probes, and end-to-end finetuning), with model-specific hyperparameter optimization and subject-disjoint cross-validation. translated_title: PPG-Bench：一个面向PPG基础模型的统一基准测试
translated_abstract: 光电容积脉搏波（PPG）正越来越多地被可穿戴设备和临床设备大规模记录，并且已开发出越来越多的PPG基础模型（FMs），用于为各种下游任务计算可复用的表征。然而这些模型难以相互比较：不同的评估使用不同的数据集、任务定义、预处理方法、下游模型头、超参数调整和基线。我们提出了PPG-Bench，一个统一的开源基准测试，评估了五个公开的PPG基础模型，涵盖九个开放获取数据集和26个任务，涉及心血管状态估计、活动、睡眠、疾病筛查和身份识别。我们在四种适应性递增的下游评估模式（线性探测、随机森林、冻结MLP探测和端到端微调）下对模型进行评估，并采用针对各模型优化的超参数调节和受试者分离的交叉验证。我们还将其与三种对照进行了比较：随机/常数基线，以及……
tldr: PPG-Bench是一个统一的开源基准测试，在九个数据集和26个任务上，通过四种下游评估模式对五个PPG基础模型进行了系统、公平的比较。
en_tdlr: PPG-Bench is a unified open-source benchmark that systematically and fairly compares five PPG foundation models across nine datasets and 26 tasks under four downstream evaluation regimes.
